name: Nutritionix
tagline: Natural language and barcode nutrition data for food apps
description: Nutritionix provides food and restaurant nutrition data via REST APIs, including natural language meal parsing, branded and common foods search, barcode lookup, and exercise calorie estimates. Developers authenticate with an app ID and API key and use the Track API for food logging and nutrition lookups in consumer and health apps.

auth.details: App ID and API key via x-app-id and x-app-key headers; self-serve developer signup at Nutritionix business API

pricing.free_tier_limits: unknown — confirm on current pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Paid production plans listed publicly (Trial ~$499/mo, Starter ~$999/mo, MVP from ~$1850/mo; custom enterprise/sales quotes also available)

example.request: curl -X POST https://trackapi.nutritionix.com/v2/natural/nutrients -H "x-app-id: YOUR_APP_ID" -H "x-app-key: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"1 banana"}'

use_cases: parse natural language meal text into nutrients
look up nutrition facts by UPC barcode
estimate calories burned for an exercise
